fields.Name: IT46 - Agent Loop Stand-In
fields.Description: Agent-loop machinery without any LLM: failed-step single-INSERT persistence, two-phase step round-trip incl. non-terminal Plan StepType, pre-aborted cancellation leaves no orphan run, non-Active agent deterministic failure with terminal Validation step, PayloadManager pure guards (applyAgentChangeRequest fence, scope round-trip, path prefixing), and the run-scoped action circuit breaker at ExecuteSingleAction against the real action engine: identical-arguments rule blocks before the engine with no log row (ALS7), attempt budget across varied arguments (ALS8), success resets both counters (ALS9), fatal lockout is argument-independent (ALS10), skipCircuitBreaker for ForEach/While/pipeline callers bypasses every rule and leaves the history untouched (ALS11). 11 checks (ALS1-ALS11), self-cleaning tagged runs/steps/action logs. Server-only (BaseAgent internals).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Agent-loop machinery without any LLM: failed-step single-INSERT persistence, two-phase step round-trip incl. non-terminal Plan StepType, pre-aborted cancellation leaves no orphan run, non-Active agent deterministic failure with terminal Validation step, PayloadManager pure guards (applyAgentChangeRequest fence, scope round-trip, path prefixing). 6 checks (ALS1-ALS6), self-cleaning tagged runs/step
